newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC files for C$250 mln debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: CIBC files for C$250 mln debenture issue.

text.p: The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce on Monday said it is filing a prospectus for a C$250 million debenture issue due October 23, 2011 in the Canadian market.

The bank said the debentures will pay interest twice a year at an annual rate of 7.0 percent until October 23, 2006. After this date, the debentures will pay interest each quarter at the three month Bankers' acceptance rate plus one percent.

The offering will be underwritten by a group of investment dealers led by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, the investment banking arm of CIBC. The expected closing date for the issue is November 1, 1996.
